active.title: At the switch, the deploy syncs exclude content/* again
active.description: At the switch, the panel's first publish to this site's buckets, both deploy syncs in .github/workflows/deploy.yml (stage and prod) exclude content/* again, so a deploy never overwrites or deletes content the panel published. Carried from AC2.3 of rc-5: Job 6 made media a list, and the old content JSON left in the buckets would break the project pages until the panel publishes.
active.provenance: Operator, 2026-11-07, rc-5 AC2.3: "Adiar a exclusão (Recommended)" — the content/* exclusion is carried to the switch (_RELEASE.json note 2026-11-07T23:05:00Z); an operator-ratified in-release deferral.
